name: refactor_dockerfile_go_multistage_scratch
description: Converts a single-stage Go Dockerfile shipping the full toolchain into a multi-stage build with a minimal final image
prompts: The Dockerfile builds a Go binary but ships the ENTIRE golang:1.22 toolchain (compiler, full Go distribution, source code) in the production image - hundreds of MB and a much larger attack surface than the single static binary actually needs at runtime. Convert it to a multi-stage build: a 'builder' stage (still FROM golang:1.22) that compiles a statically-linked binary (CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -o /app/server .), and a final stage FROM a minimal base (scratch, or gcr.io/distroless/static-debian12) that only COPY --from=builder the compiled /app/server binary and runs it. The final stage must NOT contain the Go toolchain or any `go build`/`RUN go` command - only the compiled binary. Keep EXPOSE 8080 and the same startup behavior (running the server binary).

setup_files.Dockerfile:
FROM golang:1.22

WORKDIR /app
COPY go.mod ./
COPY main.go ./
RUN go build -o server .

EXPOSE 8080
CMD ["./server"]

test_setup_files.test_dockerfile_multistage.py:
import re

text = open('Dockerfile', encoding='utf-8').read()
low = text.lower()

from_lines = re.findall(r'(?mi)^\s*FROM\s+(\S+)(?:\s+AS\s+(\S+))?', text)
assert len(from_lines) >= 2, f'expected a multi-stage build (>= 2 FROM lines), found {len(from_lines)}'

final_base = from_lines[-1][0]
assert not final_base.lower().startswith('golang'), (
    f'final stage must not be the golang toolchain image, got {final_base!r}')
assert ('scratch' in final_base.lower()) or ('distroless' in final_base.lower()), (
    f'final stage should be a minimal base (scratch or distroless), got {final_base!r}')

assert 'copy --from' in low, 'no COPY --from=<builder stage> instruction found'

# the final stage (everything after the last FROM) must not build Go code
final_stage_text = text[text.lower().rfind('\nfrom '):]
assert 'go build' not in final_stage_text.lower(), 'final stage still runs `go build` - toolchain not actually removed'

assert re.search(r'(?mi)^\s*EXPOSE\s+8080', text), 'EXPOSE 8080 was dropped'
assert 'server' in low, 'the server binary/CMD reference was lost'

print('PASS')

reference_solution.Dockerfile:
FROM golang:1.22 AS builder

WORKDIR /app
COPY go.mod ./
COPY main.go ./
RUN CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -o /app/server .

FROM scratch

COPY --from=builder /app/server /server

EXPOSE 8080
CMD ["/server"]
